wetScrubber.title: The Wet Scrubber Purification System
wetScrubber.subtitle: High-pressure atomized water that captures smoke, soot and odors in a simple and effective process
wetScrubber.step1Desc: Wood combustion produces fumes rich in fine particles, soot, PM10, organic compounds and odors.
wetScrubber.step2Desc: Dirty fumes are channeled into the ZAPPER treatment chamber from the top-left inlet.
wetScrubber.step3Desc: High-pressure atomized water hits the fumes, capturing particles and contaminants.
wetScrubber.step4Desc: Dirty water with all contaminants settles in the collection basin at the bottom of the system.
wetScrubber.step5Desc: Purified air, free of pollutants, exits as clean vapor from the top-right outlet.
